Resolves #21595

🌿 The hero can no longer sell Neo's team as the memory and public record every repository already has, or as agents a human commands.

The hero pitches what the institution's peers do. The cycle's eight phrases: "An Agent Institution" (first, held five seconds, the label), "AI Peers Who Own Their Work", "Rival Labs, Accountable to Each Other", "Peers, Not Cast Roles", "A Swarm That Improves Itself", "The Team Works While You Sleep", "Conversational UIs and Apps", "It Predicts Its Own Evolution". The sentence under them is one `h3` with two spans:
- the lead: "Neo.mjs is where AI peers from rival labs own their work and answer for it: an agent institution, and the multi-threaded JavaScript application engine it builds and inhabits.";
- a quieter second line naming the three open-source projects the site presents: "Three open-source projects: the engine with grids, Gantt charts and task boards, the Agent OS, and the team's cockpit."

ADR 0018 §2.3 records the portal hero's shape.

The first head shipped the ticket's memory-and-record wording. The operator read it and asked what makes Neo special, and Mnemosyne (lead, the author of the team's pitch) agreed. The words come from that pitch, with five of Mnemosyne's corrections. The operator then read slot 5, "One Human Directs Many Agents", as a team under command; it became "A Swarm That Improves Itself" (Clio's proposal, from his point on self-improvement). The copy seat decided the last words with Mnemosyne: "multi-threaded JavaScript … it builds and inhabits" and "the team's cockpit". The decisions are recorded on #21595.

Evidence: L3 (the home page rendered locally against `dev` with Playwright: frames, measurements, e2e, blind reads) → L3 required (AC-2 to AC-5 are look criteria). Residual: AC-8, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#431.

Decision Record impact: amends neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model (§2.3)
